verdict.rationale: Paddle is a billing and merchant-of-record platform, not an AI agent or host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows Paddle publishes MCP servers (the account MCP and docs MCP) for external agents to connect to. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Paddle itself loading third-party MCP servers.
